newsitem.title: USA: Rickel Home Centers names Joseph Nusim CEO. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Rickel Home Centers names Joseph Nusim CEO. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects Nusim's title by removing mention of him becoming chief merchandising officer).
Rickel Home Centers Inc, a home improvement retailer in Chapter 11 bankruptcy, said on Tuesday it has named Joseph Nusim president and chief executive officer, effective immediately.
Nusim's appointment is subject to approval of the Bankruptcy Court in which Rickel's chapter 11 case is pending.
Nusim succeeds Antonio Alvarez, who who had served in this position since July when Jules Borshadel left to pursue other interests, the company said.
Nusim has served as a retail consultant to a variety of chains since 1994 when he left as head of Channel Home Centers when it was acquired by Rickel.
